name: pnp-list-formatting-postcard-with-stamp
title: Postcard with Stamp
shortDescription: This SharePoint JSON view formatting sample transforms list items into postcards with a handwritten message, stamp, rotated postmark and address block.
longDescription: This SharePoint JSON view formatting sample transforms list items into postcards.

Each card renders as a postcard back with a handwritten-style message on the left and a stamp, rotated postmark and address block on the right. Colours, stamp icon and stamp/accent colours are all driven from list columns so each card can be re-skinned per item.

references.name: Use view formatting to customize SharePoint
references.description: You can use view formatting to customize how items in SharePoint lists and libraries are displayed.
